- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (positive sentiment > 0.5) — reduce forecast peak values.
- Underestimate prices after strong negative sentiment spikes (sentiment < -0.3) — adjust downward bias to avoid underreaction.
- Overshoot after recent price spikes — cap forecast peaks at 10–15% below true peak in 30d horizon.
- Mean-reversion bias: if 30d forecast is > 10% above recent 10-day average, reduce by 5–8% unless sentiment strongly bullish.
- Lagged sentiment effect: if sentiment drops sharply 2–3 days before forecast, reduce forecast by 2–5% to account for delayed reaction.
- Avoid overconfidence in early forecast days — especially when sentiment is rising — cap first 5–7 days’ forecast at 10% below true 30d mean.
